entry.title: Donut Theory 1.15.4
entry.summary: Publish the current RETRIG/Phase/shared-footer interface and remove MIDI preset/Dice commands and PAD COMMANDS menus. Ordinary notes, chord MIDI mappings, instrument settings and405parameter identities are retained. Fresh instances start on POLY; existing host instances can retain their native subtab. Native/bothARM/SDK/regressions and final host19PASS/0WARN/0FAIL. NVMe installed and owner accepted supplied startup/menu/command-removal checks on MPC XL / OS3.10.1.12. No new universal hardware au

entry.title: Donut Theory 1.15.0
entry.summary: # Donut Theory 1.15.0 - Control OSC2 phase relative to OSC1 from the main A4 Q-Link: switch DRIFT / PHASE without changing either value. - FREE retains the existing oscillator history; RESET aligns new articulations. Connected legato and chord glide preserve phase. Strum notes reset when their delayed gate starts. - Eight waves per oscillator: Sine, Triangle, Saw, Pulse, Soft Saw, Soft Pulse, Organ and Hollow. Live phase and wave changes crossfade. - Phase has its own Dice lock. Wave choices sha

entry.title: Donut Theory 1.14.2
entry.summary: # Donut Theory 1.14.2 - Aligned front selectors to one or two knob columns, with consistent heights and spacing. - FREE/SYNC now sits directly above its Rate control on the performance and MOD pages. Motion Sync no longer occupies the section title. - Standardized the footer VOICE, Dice Target and input selector widths. - Added consistent list text/arrow padding and a compact TIME layout that leaves room for numeric units. - Original artwork, fonts, knob geometry, sound engine, 391 parameter def
